o.text: From süpürmək + -gə. Cognate with Turkish süpürge.
Perhaps from Proto-Turkic *kān- (“to be satisfied”). Probably cognate with Turkish kanmak (“to believe; to be satisfied”), Turkmen ganmak (“to satisfy one's thirst; to study, master”).

Possibly from Proto-Turkic *kad-, whence also Azerbaijani qayğı; however, the intervocalic /d/ instead of expected /j/ is not quite clear.
Alternatively, from Proto-Common Turkic *kada- (“to thrust into, to plunge into”).
Compare dialectal Turkish gada.
